requirement_text: Use AAMI_SVF_WINDOW_V1 with the identical explicit AAMI_SVF_MAP_V1 allowlist for MIT-BIH and INCART.
validation_method: Mapper unit tests cover every allowlisted, paced, unknown, unmapped, and non-beat symbol.
acceptance_criterion: Both datasets use the same frozen pure mapper and no unlisted beat is coerced.

requirement_text: Prediction uses a 10-second ECG window with 5-second stride and right-edge timestamp.
validation_method: Synthetic boundary and future-sample tests.
acceptance_criterion: Exact 2500-sample windows at 250 Hz occur every 5 seconds with no sample after t.

requirement_text: Use MIT-BIH channel named exactly MLII and INCART channel named exactly II.
validation_method: Header-name selection and missing-channel exclusion tests.
acceptance_criterion: Only locked named leads are used and exclusions precede split/evaluation.

requirement_text: Split patients before windows; group MIT-BIH records 201 and 202; keep patients indivisible across partitions.
validation_method: Participant-set disjointness and 201/202 grouping assertions.
acceptance_criterion: Zero patient overlap and records 201/202 share a group.

requirement_text: All deployment transforms, including filtering and stateful rational/polyphase resampling, use current/past data only.
validation_method: Future-append, impulse-causality, and chunk-equivalence tests.
acceptance_criterion: Earlier outputs are invariant to arbitrary appended futures and chunking matches continuous streaming.

requirement_text: Gaps <=100 ms use last-value causal ZOH plus gap mask; gaps >100 ms are unfilled and break/reset state.
validation_method: Short/long synthetic gap tests with alternative futures.
acceptance_criterion: Short fills exactly equal last pre-gap sample; long-gap spanning windows are UNUSABLE and state resets.

requirement_text: Choose and freeze the majority class from training prevalence only, then evaluate unchanged everywhere.
validation_method: Fixture with held-out prevalence reversal.
acceptance_criterion: Prediction class remains determined solely by training labels.

requirement_text: Implement the locked 1D CNN architecture and training contract with train-only class weighting and fixed seeds.
validation_method: Shape, deterministic test-vector, seed, config, and checkpoint-hash tests.
acceptance_criterion: Frozen MODEL_V1 reproduces logits within tolerance and retains its SHA-256/config.

requirement_text: Fit temperature and F1 threshold only on the dedicated calibration partition after MODEL_V1 lock.
validation_method: Partition provenance assertion and calibration regression tests.
acceptance_criterion: Calibration artifact names patient count/domain and threshold is frozen before test/external use.

requirement_text: Use 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap resamples for internal/external CIs; prohibit window-level CIs.
validation_method: Known clustered fixture and paired-resample tests.
acceptance_criterion: Pooled metrics are recomputed using all windows of sampled patients and patient-macro F1 is computed per patient.

requirement_text: Evaluate frozen MODEL_V1 under controlled MIT-BIH NSTDB noise without claiming universal robustness.
validation_method: Frozen checkpoint/config provenance and SNR/noise-regime checks.
acceptance_criterion: Noise degradation report is reproducible and limited to tested regimes.

requirement_text: Run one locked INCART Lead II evaluation with frozen preprocessing, map, model, calibration, and threshold before adaptation.
validation_method: Checkpoint/map/channel hashes and no-adaptation audit.
acceptance_criterion: External evaluation occurs once under frozen inputs with patient-cluster CIs.

requirement_text: PPG, SpO2, and HR support deterministic quality/context and never form a learned AAMI-SVF classifier in core scope.
validation_method: Architecture and claim audit; missing-context/state tests.
acceptance_criterion: Primary model input remains ECG only and multimodal reports make no predictive-gain claim.

requirement_text: Open after two consecutive VALID above-threshold windows; close after two VALID below; enforce 30-second cooldown.
validation_method: Scripted transition sequences including DEGRADED and UNUSABLE.
acceptance_criterion: Exact K=2/M=2/cooldown=30 s transitions and episode counting reproduce.

requirement_text: Compare identical ECG-only and quality-aware monitors under frozen deterministic degradations.
validation_method: Paired clean/degraded deterministic replay with frozen seeds.
acceptance_criterion: Report excess episodes/hour, chattering, recheck, suppression, and reference-state preservation without sensitivity claims.

requirement_text: Construct eight controlled sites from whole training patients only; never call them hospitals or institutions.
validation_method: Client disjointness, partition-role, and patient-count audit.
acceptance_criterion: Each patient belongs to exactly one simulated training site; held-out patients are absent.
claim_boundary: Synthetic research partitions, not real institutions.

requirement_text: Run the same MODEL_V1 with eight clients, 50 rounds, one local epoch, all clients/round, and sample-count weighted deltas.
validation_method: Two-client analytical aggregation and round-log tests.
acceptance_criterion: Toy aggregate matches analytical mean and the IID run uses the locked budget.

requirement_text: Evaluate IID, label, quantity, feature/noise, and combined conditions with whole-patient integrity and matched budgets.
validation_method: Manifest invariants and config-difference audit.
acceptance_criterion: Only declared heterogeneity changes; patient pool/model/budgets remain matched.

requirement_text: FedProx changes only the local proximal objective; tune declared mu candidates on federated validation then freeze.
validation_method: mu=0 equivalence and matched-config tests.
acceptance_criterion: mu=0 matches FedAvg objective and final comparisons differ only by proximal objective.

requirement_text: Demonstrate configured Flower SecAgg+ server visibility and overhead only after FedAvg correctness.
validation_method: Instrumented aggregate correctness, dropout, and server-visible-object audit.
acceptance_criterion: Server aggregation interface lacks individual clear updates; report avoids complete-privacy claims.
claim_boundary: Aggregation-visibility claim only; not complete privacy.

requirement_text: CPU inference on the local gateway is mandatory; ESP32 remains acquisition/timestamp device unless separately benchmarked.
validation_method: At least 1,000 warmed windows for size/RAM/p50/p95/throughput and prediction-delta tests.
acceptance_criterion: A deployable gateway artifact has measured resources and accuracy delta.

requirement_text: Use real synchronized wearable sessions for engineering/domain validation only, without disease ground truth claims.
validation_method: Canonical-contract, timing, quality, latency, and replay tests.
acceptance_criterion: At least one consent-compliant session passes the same path; no sensitivity/specificity is reported.
claim_boundary: Domain validation only, not clinical validation.

requirement_text: Use IG on pre-sigmoid logit with zero normalized-input baseline, 64 Gauss-Legendre steps, signed export, and normalized absolute overlay.
validation_method: Completeness delta, eval-mode, parameters, and fixed-case-selection tests.
acceptance_criterion: TP/TN/FP/FN cases follow predeclared selection and retain raw ECG/annotations.

requirement_text: Expose /v1/infer-window with model/preprocess/contract/alert/calibration IDs, typed errors, and research-only probability semantics.
validation_method: Schema/status/version-field contract tests.
acceptance_criterion: Valid/invalid/unusable inputs produce specified responses and no diagnosis string.
claim_boundary: Probability for project target, not disease risk.

requirement_text: Render the five specified monitoring/system states and research-only metadata without diagnostic wording.
validation_method: All-state UI mapping and prohibited-wording tests.
acceptance_criterion: State labels exactly follow the contract and show quality/version/calibration domain.

requirement_text: Use locked environments, versioned configs/manifests, SHA-256 artifact identities, seeds, and common run manifests.
validation_method: Clean-environment smoke, hash verification, and manifest schema tests.
acceptance_criterion: Every retained result traces to commit/config/data/split/model/seed and hashes verify.

requirement_text: Treat G0-G22 as blocking checkpoints with artifacts, pass/fail criteria, recovery, and downstream blocks.
validation_method: Registry completeness and release gate audit.
acceptance_criterion: Exactly G0-G22 exist; no gate is silently skipped or pre-passed.

short_name: Definition of Done and release evidence
requirement_text: Satisfy every Section 44 clause and retain the Appendix B evidence package before final release.
validation_method: Evidence existence/hash/claim audit.
acceptance_criterion: All mandatory evidence exists or an explicit approved fallback removes its claim.

requirement_text: Positive windows contain at least one mapped S/V/F and no Q/unknown; negatives contain only mapped N; paced/unmapped/Q, fewer than five mapped beats, and UNUSABLE training windows are excluded.
validation_method: Boundary fixtures for positive, negative, every exclusion, and annotation interval edges.
acceptance_criterion: Every fixture receives the exact eligible label or exclusion reason.

requirement_text: Model probability describes the observed project window target; it is neither a beat-classifier output nor disease/arrhythmia probability and is not a future forecast.
validation_method: API/UI/report prohibited-claim audit.
acceptance_criterion: All exposed text identifies an observed-window research target and right-edge timestamp.

requirement_text: Exclude records missing the locked channel before split/evaluation; never select a fallback lead based on performance.
validation_method: Missing-channel fixtures and manifest timing audit.
acceptance_criterion: Every exclusion is logged before downstream work and no alternate lead enters core results.

requirement_text: Train fits weights/scalers; validation selects; calibration calibrates/thresholds; internal and external tests never tune.
validation_method: Configuration-provenance and partition-access audit.
acceptance_criterion: No held-out partition influences training, selection, preprocessing, calibration, or threshold.

requirement_text: Show eligible patient counts beside window counts for every split/site; overlapping windows never imply independent n.
validation_method: Report-schema assertion for patient and window counts.
acceptance_criterion: Every evaluation/client report exposes patient counts and does not treat windows as independent sample size.

requirement_text: Per-window CNN normalization uses only that window; feature scalers fit on training only; no whole-record or full-dataset fitting.
validation_method: Fit-scope and future-append tests.
acceptance_criterion: Held-out/future modifications cannot change fitted transforms used for earlier/training-derived outputs.

requirement_text: Represent missingness with null, validity/quality, and gap_mask fields; UNUSABLE suppresses physiological alerts and returns RECHECK_SENSOR.
validation_method: Schema and end-to-end gap/state fixtures.
acceptance_criterion: Missingness is never silently imputed and runtime behavior follows quality state.

requirement_text: Use AdamW and locked hyperparameters; primary seed 20260927 and robustness seeds 20260928/20260929 cannot become selection hyperparameters.
validation_method: Config equality and experiment-registry provenance tests.
acceptance_criterion: Release checkpoint uses predeclared selection and all seed results are reported without seed cherry-picking.

requirement_text: Expose calibration_domain=MIT-BIH-v1.0.0, calibration patient count, and uncertainty; never imply INCART/wearable/clinical calibration.
validation_method: API/UI/report claim and required-field tests.
acceptance_criterion: Every calibrated probability carries source domain, patient count, and calibration ID.

requirement_text: Within each patient-cluster bootstrap replicate recompute pooled AUPRC/AUROC/F1/sensitivity/specificity; pair model comparisons on identical sampled patient IDs and do not average per-patient AUPRC.
validation_method: Known clustered fixtures and identical-resample assertions.
acceptance_criterion: Metrics and paired differences reproduce the specified clustered computation with zero_division=0 for patient F1.

requirement_text: Use BIDMC only for synchronization, processing, rate agreement, missingness, quality, and failure behavior; document critical-care mismatch.
validation_method: Dataset-role and report-claim audit.
acceptance_criterion: No BIDMC result is presented as supervised AAMI-SVF predictive evidence.

requirement_text: DEGRADED may show POSSIBLE_PATTERN but cannot open; UNUSABLE clears confirmation and pauses counting; context absence preserves valid ECG result.
validation_method: Exhaustive scripted transition table.
acceptance_criterion: All specified quality/context combinations produce the exact monitoring state and counter behavior.

requirement_text: Count open transitions per usable hour, excess alerts against aligned reference, state transitions excluding start/stop, recheck rate, and suppression rate exactly as defined.
validation_method: Hand-computed sequence fixtures.
acceptance_criterion: Computed episode metrics exactly match reference sequences and overlapping positive windows count once.

requirement_text: Report patients per site and describe the eight-site design as a protocol/heterogeneity simulation, not institutional deployment.
validation_method: Terminology and report-schema audit.
acceptance_criterion: All FL outputs show patient counts and contain no hospital/institution claims.

requirement_text: Use frozen validation for development and test only after FL configuration freeze; store complete round logs and best-validation checkpoint.
validation_method: Partition-access and round-log completeness audit.
acceptance_criterion: No test feedback alters FL configuration and every round/config/checkpoint is traceable.

requirement_text: Feature/noise skew applies fixed NSTDB regimes to whole client training streams while primary validation/test remain clean.
validation_method: Config and provenance assertions.
acceptance_criterion: Noise is confined to declared training clients and held-out primary data hashes remain unchanged.

requirement_text: SecAgg+ does not establish anonymity, final-model attack resistance, access control, transport security, or realistic institutional-scale security; DP is extension-only.
validation_method: Report/README/API prohibited-claim audit.
acceptance_criterion: Only the implemented server update-visibility and measured-overhead claim remains.

requirement_text: Any ESP32 inference claim requires exact-board conversion, memory, operator-support, and latency evidence and is not mandatory.
validation_method: Release-claim audit conditioned on MCU artifact presence.
acceptance_criterion: Without a separate benchmark the release claims gateway inference only.

requirement_text: Use consenting adults under applicable institution/supervisor process, do not induce pathology, and record activity/placement ground truth only.
validation_method: Consent/process checklist and manifest-field audit without storing private consent data in Git.
acceptance_criterion: Collection starts only after approval and sessions contain permitted states/provenance.

requirement_text: IG is an engineering diagnostic, not causal clinical explanation; case selection is predeclared rather than visually selected.
validation_method: Case-selection provenance and report-language audit.
acceptance_criterion: Saved explanations include convergence metadata, raw signal/annotations, and no causal claim.

requirement_text: Return 400 for schema errors, 422 for unusable/incomplete windows, 500 only for server failure; WebSocket wraps the same schema and inference logic.
validation_method: Valid/invalid/unusable/server-failure and REST/WebSocket equivalence tests.
acceptance_criterion: Status codes and version fields are exact with no alternate streaming inference path.

requirement_text: Show live waveforms, quality, episode state, technical metadata, and a clearly research-only probability/history panel with calibration_domain and alert_policy_id.
validation_method: Component/state snapshot and accessibility tests.
acceptance_criterion: All persistent panels and required identifiers render for every API state.

requirement_text: Record exact source URL/version/hash/license/download date; keep raw immutable; standardize separately; build windows only after patient split.
validation_method: Manifest schema, checksum, raw immutability, and build-order tests.
acceptance_criterion: A clean scripted build reproduces versioned manifests/caches without cross-partition windows.

requirement_text: Use NHM-{date}-{track}-{NNN}; record hypothesis, data/split/config/checkpoint, metric, status, seed, owner, and allowed conclusion.
validation_method: Registry schema, ID pattern, referential-integrity, and hash tests.
acceptance_criterion: Every core experiment is predeclared and traces to frozen dependencies and evidence.

requirement_text: Fallback cuts breadth before rigor; skipped/failed privacy or other claims are explicitly removed, never silently marked passed.
validation_method: Gate/fallback/claim consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: Every non-PASS mandatory gate has an approved fallback and corresponding claim removal.

requirement_text: Resolve sample semantics, timestamp origin, rates, ADC characteristics, units/scaling, identity, packet integrity, synchronization, BPM and SpO2 provenance; all remain VERIFICATION_REQUIRED until measured.
validation_method: Bench measurements, firmware/backend inspection, schema fixtures, timing/jitter and packet tests.
acceptance_criterion: G1 cannot pass until each required field has evidence or an explicit unavailable status/versioned limitation.
notes: Preserves OBSERVED_MONGODB_SCHEMA_V0 without assigning units or physiological meaning.

requirement_text: Version participant/session/device/firmware/config/timestamp/sample/raw/derived/quality/provenance/missingness fields under HARDWARE_DATA_CONTRACT_V1.
validation_method: JSON Schema fixtures and backward-incompatible-change tests.
acceptance_criterion: All required fields/types/clock meanings are explicit and observed MongoDB V0 is not silently treated as canonical.

requirement_text: MIT-BIH is core, INCART external, NSTDB noise, BIDMC engineering, WEARABLE_V1 domain validation; PTB-XL is removed from executable v2.2 scope.
validation_method: Dataset-role registry and report-input audit.
acceptance_criterion: No result crosses its dataset's allowed conclusion and PTB-XL is absent from core execution configs.

requirement_text: Use VALID/DEGRADED/UNUSABLE; tune engineering thresholds on training/noise-development resources only; held-out tests cannot tune.
validation_method: Hard-failure, threshold-provenance, and runtime-action tests.
acceptance_criterion: UNUSABLE suppresses physiological alert; DEGRADED lowers trust; thresholds have non-clinical provenance.

requirement_text: Implement all data, timing, windows, synchronization, causal preprocessing/resampling, quality, label, split, model, FL, privacy, API, episode, dashboard, reproducibility, and e2e tests.
validation_method: Full offline/unit/integration/leakage/e2e suite plus component gate reports.
acceptance_criterion: Every mandatory matrix row passes or blocks its named gate.

requirement_text: Retain every Section 41 and Appendix B contract, manifest, audit, model, evaluation, FL, privacy, deployment, wearable, API/dashboard, test, reproduction, limitation, and viva artifact.
validation_method: Existence, status, SHA-256, gate, and requirement linkage audit.
acceptance_criterion: Release manifest has every mandatory artifact/hash/gate/limitation and no fabricated future hash.

requirement_text: The system is a research prototype, not diagnostic, clinical decision support, treatment advice, safety evidence, or clinical readiness.
validation_method: Repository/API/UI/report prohibited-claim scan and human review.
acceptance_criterion: No committed or generated user-facing artifact makes a prohibited clinical claim.
claim_boundary: Research-only; not diagnostic or clinical decision support.

requirement_text: Wearable validation lacks disease ground truth and cannot support clinical sensitivity/specificity or calibration claims.
validation_method: Wearable report metric/wording audit.
acceptance_criterion: Only quality/timing/latency/output-distribution/domain compatibility conclusions appear.

requirement_text: Federated clients are synthetic research partitions and are never represented as real hospitals, clinics, institutions, or deployed populations.
validation_method: Terminology scan across code, schemas, logs, figures, API, and reports.
acceptance_criterion: All site labels and claims explicitly say simulated research partitions.

requirement_text: SecAgg+ supports only the implemented server aggregation-visibility claim, not complete privacy, anonymity, or all-attack protection.
validation_method: Privacy-claim checklist and server-object instrumentation.
acceptance_criterion: Every privacy statement is bounded by configured simulation evidence and limitations.

requirement_text: PPG/SpO2/HR provide deterministic quality/context, synchronization, and operational robustness—not learned arrhythmia prediction.
validation_method: Model-input/schema and report-claim audit.
acceptance_criterion: No PPG/SpO2/HR feature enters the learned AAMI-SVF classifier and no predictive-gain claim is made.

requirement_text: Calibration is MIT-BIH source-domain under small-patient uncertainty and is not wearable-domain or clinical calibration.
validation_method: Required metadata and prohibited-claim tests.
acceptance_criterion: Calibration domain, patient count, and ID accompany probability everywhere.

requirement_text: G0-G22 are PASS or explicitly downgraded under documented fallback; no gate is silently skipped.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: G0-G22 are PASS or explicitly downgraded under documented fallback; no gate is silently skipped.

requirement_text: Dataset, split, client, preprocessing, model, calibration, API, and release artifacts have immutable IDs/hashes.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: Dataset, split, client, preprocessing, model, calibration, API, and release artifacts have immutable IDs/hashes.

requirement_text: A clean environment runs tests and the CPU smoke pipeline from documented commands.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: A clean environment runs tests and the CPU smoke pipeline from documented commands.

requirement_text: MODEL_V1 has internal, noise, and external evaluation with patient-level uncertainty.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: MODEL_V1 has internal, noise, and external evaluation with patient-level uncertainty.

requirement_text: PPG/SpO2/HR, synchronization, quality, episode, and quality-aware comparison pass without learned multimodal claims.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: PPG/SpO2/HR, synchronization, quality, episode, and quality-aware comparison pass without learned multimodal claims.

requirement_text: FedAvg, non-IID, and matched FedProx are reproducible with whole-patient client integrity.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: FedAvg, non-IID, and matched FedProx are reproducible with whole-patient client integrity.

requirement_text: SecAgg+ passes correctness or its implemented-privacy claim is explicitly removed under emergency fallback.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: SecAgg+ passes correctness or its implemented-privacy claim is explicitly removed under emergency fallback.

requirement_text: Gateway size, memory, and latency are measured; any ESP32 inference claim has separate exact-board evidence.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: Gateway size, memory, and latency are measured; any ESP32 inference claim has separate exact-board evidence.

requirement_text: At least one real synchronized wearable session passes the canonical path and replay/live demo.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: At least one real synchronized wearable session passes the canonical path and replay/live demo.

requirement_text: API/dashboard wording is research-only and exposes quality/model/calibration/policy versions.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: API/dashboard wording is research-only and exposes quality/model/calibration/policy versions.

requirement_text: Final repository contains evidence checklist, experiment registry, limitations, and viva defense map.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: Final repository contains evidence checklist, experiment registry, limitations, and viva defense map.

requirement_text: The team distinguishes system scope/non-scope, source facts, engineering decisions, experiments, and remaining risks.
validation_method: Release evidence and gate consistency audit.
acceptance_criterion: The team distinguishes system scope/non-scope, source facts, engineering decisions, experiments, and remaining risks.

requirement_text: Use AUPRC as primary threshold-independent metric and report AUROC, F1, sensitivity, specificity, precision, confusion matrix, alert episodes/hour, and patient-macro F1 as applicable.
validation_method: Known-score fixtures, threshold provenance, and report-schema tests.
acceptance_criterion: Each experiment reports its predeclared metrics with the frozen threshold and correct statistical unit.
notes: Added during the manual second audit; metric coverage was implicit in the first draft.

requirement_text: Analyze patient, S/V/F composition, quality, noise/SNR, training-defined HR bins, dataset, threshold region, and wearable output/quality-only slices without identity disclosure.
validation_method: Slice-definition, identity-redaction, and training-bin provenance tests.
acceptance_criterion: All specified slices are reported; wearable slice contains no labeled-accuracy claim.
notes: Added during the manual second audit.

requirement_text: Public builds are scripted from URLs/checksums; private wearable raw data is never committed; split/client manifests have no manual spreadsheet edits; documented one-command test/build/train/FL/evaluate surfaces exist.
validation_method: Clean checkout command tests, Git tracked-file scan, and generated-manifest provenance audit.
acceptance_criterion: A clean CPU environment reproduces smoke/evidence without MongoDB, private data, or undocumented manual steps.
notes: Added during the manual second audit.

requirement_text: PTB-XL is removed from executable v2.2 core scope and cannot become a core dependency without a versioned Class C revision.
validation_method: Core config/input scan.
acceptance_criterion: No core experiment or gate consumes PTB-XL.
claim_boundary: PTB-XL not in executable core scope.
notes: Existing local files are preserved but not consumed.

requirement_text: A learned ECG+PPG+SpO2/HR AAMI-SVF classifier is out of scope because compatible supervised labels do not exist.
validation_method: Model-input and experiment-registry scan.
acceptance_criterion: No planned or released learned primary classifier consumes context modalities.

requirement_text: Differential privacy is outside Level-1 mandatory scope and may be added only as a separately versioned extension after core gates.
validation_method: Privacy configuration and claim scan.
acceptance_criterion: No mandatory gate or core conclusion depends on DP.

requirement_text: ESP32 inference is not required; it may be claimed only after separately versioned exact-board evidence.
validation_method: Deployment registry and release-claim scan.
acceptance_criterion: Mandatory deployment remains gateway and no MCU claim exists without separate benchmark.
